title: Environment and digital boundaries
intro: Shaping your environment makes deciding easier in an urge moment. Filters and limits put a brake on hard moments.
honesty: No filter is unbeatable. A filter is a brake; the real strength is your skills and your plan.

checklist.label: Charge your phone outside the bedroom
Switch your screen to greyscale at night
Separate your work and sleep areas
Plan an activity for your risky hours

grayscaleHint: Greyscale makes the screen less appealing. iPhone: Settings > Accessibility > Display & Text Size > Colour Filters. Android: Settings > Digital Wellbeing > Bedtime mode, or Accessibility > Colour correction.

ios.title: iPhone: Screen Time
steps: Open Settings > Screen Time and turn Screen Time on.
Go to Content & Privacy Restrictions > Content Restrictions > Web Content and choose "Limit Adult Websites".
Set Downtime to match your risky hours.
Use App Limits to set a daily time for trigger apps.
If you like, set a Screen Time passcode and have someone you trust keep it.
ios.note: All these settings work inside the iPhone itself; the app doesn't access any data.

android.title: Android: Digital Wellbeing
steps: Open Settings > Digital Wellbeing & parental controls.
Use app timers to set a daily time for trigger apps.
Use Focus mode to pause distracting apps during your risky hours.
Turn on Bedtime mode: the screen goes greyscale at night and notifications go quiet.
android.note: These settings work inside the phone itself; the app doesn't access any data.

reminder.title: Risky-hour reminder
reminder.body: If one of the apps you choose is opened during your risky hours, a gentle "Focus time" reminder appears. It doesn't block anything; it only reminds you.
reminder.disclosure: With the "Usage access" permission, this feature reads which apps are opened and when, only on this phone. This information is never sent anywhere or stored; it's only used to check whether a reminder is needed.
reminder.grantHint: Find this app in the list that opens, turn the permission on, then come back here.
reminder.appsHint: Choose the ones that usually trigger you (e.g. social media, browser).
reminder.noHours: First choose at least one risky time range.
reminder.unavailable: This feature works in the full version of the app (Android); it isn't available in this version.
reminder.delay: The phone runs this check about every 15 minutes; the reminder may be a few minutes late.
reminder.notifBody: A good moment to remember your plan.
